pkgmetadata.longdescription: CoW (Compositor on Wayland) is a stacking window manager in the spirit of FVWM and MWM, built on top of River as the Wayland compositor. It provides server-side decorations, containers with tabs, native menus, an internal DSL with filtering, and IPC scripting (moocow) so the same commands work both in configuration files and at runtime.
